**Is your company part of a larger enterprise group?**

- Yes
- No

***

**If yes: what is your company's role within the group?**

- Head office / parent company
- Subsidiary
- Branch or division

***

**Where is the head office of the group located?**

- Same country
- Another EU country
- Outside the EU

***

**What is the ownership structure of your company?**
*(Select all that apply)*

- Privately owned by one or more individuals
- Family-owned business
- Employee-owned or cooperative
- Publicly listed on a stock exchange
- Majority state-owned
- Majority foreign-owned
- Other (please specify)

***

**What share of your company's equity is owned by foreign investors?**

- None (0%)
- Less than 10%
- 10–49%
- 50% or more (majority foreign-owned)

***

**Does your company have a formal board of directors?**

- Yes
- No

***

**Does your company have a formal supervisory board?**

- Yes
- No

***

**How many sites or locations does your company operate from?**

- One location only
- 2–5 locations
- More than 5 locations
